description:
Change which agent answers a WhatsApp number (inbound_agent_id, or null for none), its label, or how the agent behaves on it. Only the fields you send change.

Requires scope `whatsapp:write`.

inbound_agent_id.description: The agent that answers, or null to stop answering.

human_pause_minutes.description: On a number shared with the WhatsApp Business app, how long the agent waits after a person replies from the app.

inactivity_minutes.description: Minutes of quiet after which a conversation closes.

offline_reply.description: Sent instead of an AI reply when the balance is too low. Empty sends nothing.

typing_indicator.description: Mark messages read and show "typing…" while the agent works.

voice_note_replies.description: Answer a voice note with a voice note in the agent's voice (classic and sarvam engines).

name: update_whatsapp_account
title: Update a WhatsApp number
